description: Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET 2) to engineer and implement automated testing solutions that improve software quality, reliability, and delivery efficiency across business-critical applications. The ideal candidate will bring strong programming fundamentals, hands-on test automation experience, and an automation-first mindset. You will collaborate with software engineers and product teams to shift quality earlier in the development lifecycle, develop reusable automation frameworks, and leverage AI-assisted engineering to accelerate test development, improve coverage, and prevent defects from reaching production. You will contribute to our established AI-native engineering practices by leveraging AI-assisted software development tools and building agentic AI applications. You are expected to integrate AI into your daily engineering workflows to improve development velocity, software quality, and efficiency while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals. Success in this role requires a continuous learning mindset, responsible use of AI tools, and a focus on delivering measurable business value while optimizing AI resource consumption and costs. Job Description Core Responsibilities Quality Engineering: Design and execute functional, integration, API, UI, and end-to-end tests to ensure application quality and reliability. Test Automation: Develop and maintain reusable, scalable automated test scripts and frameworks using Java, Selenium, TestNG, Playwright, or comparable technologies. Shift-Left Testing: Partner with developers to validate requirements, identify defects early, and integrate testing throughout the development lifecycle. API & Integration Testing: Develop automated API and service-level tests, validate integrations, and identify compatibility and functional issues. Automation Frameworks: Build and enhance reusable test utilities, page objects, test data, reporting components, and automation libraries. CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing, rapid feedback, and reliable software releases. AI-Native Quality Engineering: Leverage AI-assisted tools for test generation, automation development, defect analysis, and test optimization while validating outputs for correctness and reliability. Defect Management: Independently investigate, reproduce, document, and track defects through resolution, collaborating with development teams on root cause analysis. Engineering Excellence: Apply object-oriented programming, coding standards, TDD/BDD principles, and maintainable design patterns to test automation. Continuous Improvement: Improve automation stability, execution efficiency, test coverage, and defect detection through engineering-led improvements. Agile Collaboration: Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, and retrospectives while communicating quality risks and progress effectively. Required Qualifications 2+ years of experience in software test automation, quality engineering, or software development. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of software testing principles, Agile methodologies, SDLC, and software testing lifecycle. Good object-oriented programming, debugging, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Experience developing maintainable automated tests and independently troubleshooting automation failures. Understanding of functional, regression, integration, API, and cross-browser testing. Required Skills Programming: Java, object-oriented programming, and automation scripting. Test Automation: Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, or equivalent frameworks. Modern Automation: Familiarity with Playwright, WebdriverIO, JavaScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies. API Testing: REST APIs, web services testing, and API automation tools or libraries. CI/CD: Jenkins, Concourse, or equivalent continuous integration tools. Test Design: Test case development, automation coverage, regression testing, and TDD/BDD concepts. Version Control: Git and collaborative development practices. Test Management: Jira, Octane, or comparable defect and test management platforms. Test Reporting: Test execution analysis, defect reporting, and automation results interpretation. AI-Native Engineering Expectati ons Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test case generation, automation scripting, debugging, and defect analysis. Apply AI to improve test coverage, identify edge cases, optimize test data, and reduce repetitive testing activities. Review and validate AI-generated test cases and automation code for correctness, security, and maintainability. Demonstrate an automation-first mindset and continuously adopt AI-enabled quality engineering practices that improve productivity and test effectiveness. Good to have Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, WebdriverIO, or Appium. Exposure to JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, NPM, and mobile automation testing. Experience with API automation, service virtualization, mocking frameworks, or contract testing. Familiarity with test reporting solutions such as Allure and quality engineering dashboards. Understanding of performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing concepts. Experience with desktop application testing on Windows or macOS. Exposure to AI-assisted coding tools, AI-generated test cases, or intelligent test automation platforms. Experience implementing automated regression suites within CI/CD pipelines. title: Software Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. KLA is a global leader in process control and yield management solutions for the electronics and semiconductor industries. For decades, KLA has worked at the leading edge of deep science , taking on complex technical challenges that often take years to solve. By combining expertise in optics, sensors, machine learning, data analytics, and software engineering, KLA helps enable the ideas and devices that transform the future of technology. At KLA, innovation is driven by a belief that precision matters at the smallest scale —from nanometer‑level measurement to world‑class manufacturing quality. Our solutions support advanced manufacturing across wafers, integrated circuits, packaging, and printed circuit boards, making everyday technologies such as smartphones, data centers, autonomous systems, and connected devices possible. KLA fosters an engineering‑driven culture that values rigorous testing, continuous improvement, and collaboration across global teams. Software Quality Engineers at KLA contribute to products with real‑world impact while growing their careers in an environment that encourages curiosity, ownership, and long‑term technical excellence. The ICOS Division at KLA focuses on advanced optical inspection and metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, with strong emphasis on component inspection, wafer safety, and high‑precision optical systems . ICOS products play a critical role in ensuring manufacturing quality, yield, and reliability for leading semiconductor customers. ICOS products operate at the intersection of optics, mechanics, electronics, and software , making them inherently complex and quality‑sensitive. The division’s success depends not only on innovation in inspection capability, but also on robust system validation, safe operation, and predictable software behavior across diverse customer environments . Job Responsibilities Test Automation Engineer Understand the system and customer workflows end-to-end by analyzing product requirements, architecture, and real customer use cases; translate these into automation strategy and test coverage for web applications and web services. Participate early in the SDLC by reviewing functional/system requirements and designs to ensure testability , identify risks, and define measurable acceptance criteria aligned with user journeys and service/API contracts. Build and maintain a scalable test automation framework using Playwright (web UI automation) with strong engineering practices (reusable utilities, page/component patterns, stable selectors, test data strategy, reporting). Automate critical user flows (smoke, regression, and high-risk business paths) by modeling realistic user behavior and validating the complete workflow across UI, backend services, and data stores. Develop automated validations for Web Services / APIs (service-level functional checks, contract validation, negative testing, error handling) and integrate them with UI flows for true end-to-end quality coverage. Apply AI-assisted automation practices to improve reliability and maintenance efficiency (e.g., smarter test generation, adaptive/self-healing approaches, and AI-enabled test execution where applicable) to reduce script fragility and speed up automation development. Create and maintain test plans, automation suites, and execution pipelines to run on-demand and on schedule; ensure results are observable via dashboards/logs/reports and are usable for release decisions. Execute and monitor automated test runs across builds; analyze failures to distinguish product defects vs. test issues , improve stability, and keep the automation suite production-grade. Measure and communicate automation coverage, ROI, quality trends, and release risk ; continuously prioritize automation work based on defect trends and usage-critical paths. Collaborate with cross-functional and global stakeholders (developers, architects, product owners, system engineers) to improve testability and promote quality best practices throughout the lifecycle Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Software Engineering, Automation, Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field. Familiarity with software quality control processes and a good understanding of web UI testing concepts. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as C/C++, Python, Perl, or VBScript. Experience with Visual Studio, automated testing frameworks, MySQL or Oracle databases, and Linux commands is preferred. Fluent in spoken and written English. Strong initiative, fast learning ability, proactive attitude, and excellent team spirit. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
